contract: Howl Instance wire v10; header version is the complete compatibility boundary. Every snapshot carries exactly one bounded complete properties packet after graphics and before end. Packed complete carriage reconstructs exact frozen text_v1 before semantic decoding.

cases.note: Empty hello frame establishes the explicit attach boundary; the frame header version already identifies the complete wire contract.
Welcome returns only the connection-local client identity; no version or feature matrix is negotiated.
Observation request carries revision and history window offset in big endian.
Raw observation is a distinct framing-v8 request with the same revision/history payload; only the snapshot text transport differs.
Delta observation names the exact prior revision/history window it can reuse; the endpoint may fall back to a complete raw snapshot.
Packed complete observation uses the same exact revision/history request payload; only complete text carriage changes.
Negotiated interaction-state observation is an explicit zero-byte request, separate from text_v1.
Mode-directed caller interaction state is correlated to one canonical terminal revision without changing text_v1.
Reserved interaction-state bytes remain canonical zero.
Raw byte compatibility lane is opaque and binary-safe.
Paste is semantic but transports exact binary payload including NUL.
Typed key carries physical identity, modifiers, action, alternate identities, legacy bytes, and committed UTF-8 text.
Typed mouse carries signed cell row, column, optional pixel coordinates, modifiers, and held-button state.
Focus transition is a one-byte semantic typed-input body.
Geometry leadership is assigned by explicit connection-local client id.
Rows and columns with a zero cell-pixel pair preserve accepted pixel metrics.
Only the frozen semantic signal catalogue crosses the wire.
Command results correlate by request kind and bounded semantic result code.
511 legacy bytes are the exact accepted ceiling, preserving one byte of canonical VT scratch for Meta ESC prefixing.
Complete renderer-neutral text_v1 observation: one bounded zlib stream carries presentation, grapheme, wide-cell, style/color, and OSC 8 semantics.
Raw observation carries the identical validated text_v1 records in snapshot_raw_data without a zlib envelope.
Magic mismatch is rejected before payload interpretation.
Unknown framing version is rejected.
Every reserved header bit is canonical zero.
Unknown frame kind is rejected before payload parsing.
Declared payload length is bounded before read/allocation.
Partial frame header cannot be interpreted.
Declared payload must be fully present.
Hello is exactly zero bytes; compatibility/version negotiation does not live in the attach payload.
Unknown key transition action is rejected.
Surrogate halves are not Unicode scalar key identities.
Committed key text must be valid UTF-8.
512 legacy bytes are rejected; the frozen maximum is 511.
Absent optional Unicode identities must carry zero storage.
Unknown mouse button values are rejected.
Absent pixel coordinates must be encoded as zero.
Unknown focus transition is rejected.
Reserved snapshot-begin flag bit is rejected immediately.
Text record reserved bytes are canonical zero.
Unknown text cell style bits are rejected rather than guessed.
Every hyperlink id referenced by captured rows must resolve exactly once before snapshot end.
Snapshot data is meaningful only between begin and end.
Snapshot end cannot appear without an active observation cut.
Frames concatenate without transport delimiters; header lengths alone preserve empty hello and client-id welcome boundaries.
Corrupt zlib snapshot bytes are rejected before text semantics are exposed.
Declared uncompressed snapshot length is bounded before allocation or decompression.
Selection extraction carries two inclusive stable points plus expected geometry and screen-bank identity.
Selected text response is opaque bounded UTF-8 and may contain grapheme scalars and newlines.
Selection extraction request has one fixed twelve-byte payload.
Image pixels are fetched separately by the exact id and content generation advertised by a snapshot graphics manifest.
One exact RGBA8 generation is bounded by begin/data/end framing independently of the 4 MiB text snapshot.
RGBA8 byte count must exactly equal width times height times four.
The v3 snapshot keeps text_v1 unchanged and carries one separate lightweight visible graphics manifest before snapshot_end.
A complete raw revision 10 baseline is followed by observe_delta(after_revision=10); revision 11 carries explicit row_shift=0, changes row 0 and reuses row 1 from the named baseline.
Delta data cannot be decoded without the complete raw revision named by observe_delta.
A complete raw A,Z baseline is shifted upward by one row. Delta row 0 reuses baseline row 1 (Z); the newly exposed bottom row is sent in full as B.
After row_shift=1 the newly exposed bottom row has no baseline source and therefore cannot use a zero-row reuse marker.
Geometry leader supplies exact 11x24 pixel cells.
One missing pixel metric is malformed.
V8 refuses the old four-byte resize payload.
Older executable/client bundles fail the complete framing boundary.
Optional empty icon differs from absent; shell mark and progress belong to the same coherent cut.
Required coherent property envelope is exact.
Required coherent property envelope is exact.
Reject malformed bounded properties.
Reject malformed bounded properties.
Reject malformed bounded properties.
Reject malformed bounded properties.
Reject malformed bounded properties.
v8 cannot silently omit current canonical properties.
Packed complete observation may carry a rich row verbatim when run packing would expand it; unpack reconstructs exact text_v1 before semantic decoding.
Packed complete observation expands one real Zig-produced attribute run into four exact text_v1 cells before ordinary semantic decoding.
Packed envelope length is exact; a larger declared packed body cannot be satisfied by the zlib stream.
Packed carriage still requires one exact complete zlib stream.
Packed rows accept only explicit verbatim or runs carriage modes.
A packed attribute run cannot claim more cells than remain in the canonical row.
